_comment: Provider registry. Edited from /admin, committed to this public repo like any method change. The web app never executes `command`; only the local Python pipeline does. See lib/providers.ts for the security boundary. Extractor order is priority: the first enabled extractor wins, and an enabled API entry beats every CLI below it. The run record stores which one actually ran.

providers.label: Gemini
providers.note: Re-measured 2026-09-26 and enabled from 2026-09-28. gemini-3.5-flash answered a full coding category (75 calls at the pipeline's 6 workers) with 0 errors and grounded 75 of 75; the 31% 503 rate seen on 2026-08-26 is gone. gemini-3.8-flash was also tried: 0 errors but grounded 1 of 30, so it measures memory rather than search and is not used. Grounding still cannot be forced; the grounding check (checks.py rule 7) holds a week where this stops searching.

providers.label: Claude (API)
providers.note: Hosted batch extractor. Earlier comparison with 150 archived answers measured agreement, not a validated noise floor or extraction accuracy. Declared conflict: it reads answers about its own products.

providers.label: Claude Code (local CLI)
providers.note: CLI extraction is disabled by the resolver until filesystem and network isolation are qualified. This entry does not provide a fallback when the hosted API is unavailable.

providers.label: Codex (local CLI)
providers.note: CLI extraction is disabled by the resolver until filesystem and network isolation are qualified. Local engine operation is configured separately.

providers.label: Claude Code (local)
providers.note: Own chart row, not a substitute for the hosted claude engine: this is a coding agent with a different system prompt, and it volunteers that it is made by Anthropic. Enabled, which means the weekly run must happen on this machine: see scripts/weekly-run.cmd.

providers.label: Codex (local)
providers.note: Own chart row, not a substitute for the hosted chatgpt engine. In testing it ranked Claude Code above OpenAI's own Codex. Enabled for the same reason as claude-code.
